newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's 10-yr spread sets new record low at 84 bps. [CORRECTED 11:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Spain's 10-yr spread sets new record low at 84 bps. [CORRECTED 11:25 GMT]

text.p: Spain's 10-year yield spread over Bunds hit a new all-time low on Tuesday (corrects from "Monday") at 84 basis points, dealers said.
At the same time the June long bond future was trading at around 115.78, six basis points higher than yesterday. The 10-year cash benchmark was trading at 105.54, yielding 6.57 percent.

Dealers said bono strength was due to a new wave of optimism after Ecofin on Monday backed Spain's convergence plan. They added that expectations of tame April CPI, due on Wednesday, and a consequent monetary easing were also boosting prices.
The previous record low for the 10-year spread over Bunds was set at 85 basis points on January 28.
